profile.note: METAR pass: 'now' is 5 minutes after each report, with the TAF then in force, Depart and Land. Forecast pass: each TAF is evaluated at hourly ticks and at 5 minutes before/after every FM/BECMG/TEMPO/PROB/validity/month-roll boundary, while that TAF is still the one in force, paired with the METAR then in force. Default PPL / Cessna 172 / VFR.

field_defaults.runways: The SA runway database has no foreign airports. field.runways is empty. The engine then treats the whole wind as worst-case crosswind. That is stated engine policy, not a bug, and those NO-GOs are counted separately.
field_defaults.lat_lon: Taken from aviationweather.gov stationinfo (not invented). Night is only computed when lat/lon are present.
field_defaults.elev: Taken from aviationweather.gov stationinfo, metres converted to feet. Density altitude needs elevation.
